messages:
liz_sales: Quick heads-up: Acme live PoC tomorrow 10am PT. They care about time-to-first-token (TTFT) for chat UX and want to simulate 30 concurrent users with 90s bursts to ~70 qps. Can infra + SE standby? @raj_se

raj_se: On it. Which model variant and quantization are we using? Need sample prompts and expected concurrency pattern.

liz_sales: rwd/fast-13b-quant (same as sandbox). I'll DM the prompt set. Buyer also asked: how do short high-rate bursts affect billing vs steady traffic? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

raj_se: Billing: hosted = per-token; Dedicated = baseline commit + optional burst pool (contact AE). For demo, let's focus on latency. Possible causes: batching behavior, inflight limits, or KV/cache coldness.

anya_engineer: Pulled logs from last PoC run. Snips:
[2025-11-08T17:14:02Z] req=xyz01 model=fast-13b-quant batch=6 TTFT_ms=320 p95_ms=1450 gpu_util=58 inflight=20 queue_ms=980 cache_hit=false
[2025-11-08T17:14:03Z] req=xyz02 model=fast-13b-quant batch=1 TTFT_ms=115 p95_ms=280 gpu_util=62 inflight=3 queue_ms=15 cache_hit=true
Conclusion: batched requests increased queueing and TTFT.

mike_infra: Found configuration mismatch: instance max_inflight set to 12 but autoscaler assumes 28 inflight for its sizing calculations.
service.yml snippet:
max_inflight_per_instance: 12
autoscaler.target_inflight: 28

raj_se: That'll explain ~1s queue_ms. Short fixes: (1) reduce target_batch_size to 3 during demo, (2) temporarily raise max_inflight to 28, or (3) route to dedicated low-latency pool.

anya_engineer: Memory note: raising inflight to 28 increases peak memory but still OK on 80GB A100 for this model. Preferred: reduce batch target and pre-warm prefixes into KV cache.

liz_sales: How long to pre-warm? Buyer wants assurance before demo.

anya_engineer: With 200 representative prompts replayed we see KV warms in 45-90s. Example warmup command:
for p in prompts.txt; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" -d "{\"model\":\"rwd/fast-13b-quant\",\"prompt\":\"$p\"}" & done

mike_infra: Also noticed control-plane rate-limiter hit for that token during earlier spike. Response headers showed:
X-RateLimit-Limit: 200
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 120
I'll push a temporary token override to 1500/s for the demo window.

raj_se: I'll run a 12-minute synthetic: 2m warm, 6m steady @30 qps, then a 90s burst to 70 qps. Config for test: target_batch=3, max_inflight=24, pre-warm done. Will post results.

deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd/fast-13b-quant started by @anya_engineer

sre_bot: Reminder: routing option available -> route=dedicated-demo-usw2 (low-latency pool). Use for guaranteed demo runs.

mike_infra: Provisioned dedicated-demo-usw2 and applied rate override. ETA ~8m to be active.

liz_sales: Thanks all. Raj, once you post the metrics I'll update the SOW and the one-pager SLA language for the buyer. They asked if we can promise p95 < 1s for interactive; what's realistic?

raj_se: If routed to dedicated-demo and cache pre-warmed with batch<=3, we expect median TTFT <200ms and p95 <=900ms in our tests. On shared hosted without pre-warm, p95 can spike to ~1-1.6s under heavy bursts.

anya_engineer: Agreed. I'll attach the latency graph and the raw log excerpt after the test.

liz_sales: Perfect. Please keep updates in this thread and ping if anything changes.
